    Critter hunt

    Privacy at Wonder Lab

    Wonder Lab is a small learning site for kids. It collects as little as it can.

    Playing without signing in

    Stars, badges and settings stay on your device, in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.

    Grown-up accounts

    A parent or teacher signs in with an email address. We use it only to email sign-in codes. There are no passwords, no ads, no tracking and no third-party scripts.

    Kid profiles

    A grown-up creates each kid profile and gives consent for that child. A profile holds a nickname, a Pip color, an optional pair of secret pictures, and the child's progress: stars, badges, trophies and critters found. No email, real name, birthday, photo or location. Only the grown-up who made the profile can see it.

    Deleting

    Removing a kid, a family or a class, or deleting your account, deletes that data right away. Grown-ups can do this on the grown-up page.

    The demo

    "Try the demo" and "Play the demo" keep everything in your browser and never send it to us.
